title: Token Utility Is Selection-Conditioned: Coupled Selection of Prompt Context and Response Supervision for Efficient Instruction Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2609.22943v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Efficient large language model (LLM) instruction tuning requires selecting response supervision with supporting prompt context. Existing methods typically value both sides separately, risking selection-state mismatch between valuation and retained training subsets. BRIDGE (Budgeted Response-Prompt Interaction via Directional Gradient-guided Efficient Token Selection) captures selection-conditioned token utility through a shared validation-directed interaction surrogate valuing each side under the other's retained state. Budgeted alternating selection coordinates retained subsets by aggregating precomputed interactions over the current opposite-side subset to update conditional scores. Structure-aware projection converts conditional response scores into coherent supervision spans. Across three model families, BRIDGE leads compared selection methods overall in mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following. In mathemati

translated_title: Token效用是选择条件相关的：面向高效指令微调的提示上下文与响应监督耦合选择
translated_abstract: 高效的大语言模型（LLM）指令微调需要在支持性提示上下文下选择响应监督。现有方法通常对两者分别进行价值评估，存在评估结果与保留训练子集之间选择状态不匹配的风险。BRIDGE（基于预算的响应-提示交互与方向性梯度引导的高效Token选择）通过一个共享的、以验证集为导向的交互代理模型来捕捉选择条件相关的Token效用，即在对方保留状态下对每一侧进行价值评估。预算约束下的交替选择通过在当前对侧子集上聚合预计算的交互信息来更新条件分数，从而协调两侧的保留子集。结构感知投影将条件响应分数转换为连贯的监督片段。在三个模型家族上，BRIDGE在数学推理、代码生成和指令遵循任务中总体上优于所比较的选择方法。在数学……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出BRIDGE方法，通过共享的验证导向交互代理模型捕捉选择条件相关的Token效用，实现提示上下文与响应监督的耦合交替选择，从而在数学推理、代码生成和指令遵循任务上显著提升LLM高效指令微调的效果。
en_tdlr: BRIDGE captures selection-conditioned token utility via a shared validation-directed interaction surrogate, enabling coupled alternating selection of prompt context and response supervision that outperforms existing methods in efficient LLM instruction tuning across math reasoning, code generation, and instruction following.
